messages.subject: Project Cedar - contract mark-up (buyer)
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Our mark-up of the sale contract is attached. The main points: TOGC mechanics tightened in clause 4; rent-free top-up reflected in apportionments; Unit 5 service-charge indemnity at clause 6; and we've left the warranty cap and claims period for discussion - our client's starting position is the full price for 18 months.

Grateful for your comments.

James

messages.subject: RE: Project Cedar - contract mark-up (seller response)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Seller's response attached (redline on yours). The seller won't accept full-price warranty exposure: we've capped aggregate warranty liability at 25% of the price (£3,562,500), reduced the claims period to 12 months and added a £25,000 de minimis per claim. We've also moved the completion long-stop time to 3.00 pm. TOGC and the Unit 5 indemnity are agreed.

If the cap works for your client I think we're close to exchange.

Oliver Jennings
Birchall Stone LLP
